Characterized no-nudge behavior. Waypoint passes gc sling without --nudge: gc --city <city> --rig waypoint-live sling waypoint-live/codex <root> --no-formula. Gas City 1.1.0 has --nudge but no --no-nudge/--skip-poke CLI flag. Source inspection shows the sling domain supports SkipPoke, but the CLI does not expose it; plain routing calls PokeController after metadata routing. For Waypoint's convoy root, Gas City treats the root as a container and expands open child Beads; retained GC_SLING_TRACE from /tmp/waypoint-gascity-sling-trace.log shows default mol-do-work formula instantiation for 12 children even though Waypoint passed --no-formula at the root. The retained live run at /var/folders/0m/6rps8nhn6p9180d8gzj40m1c0000gn/T/waypoint-gascity-live-JF7s1i reached waypoint start successfully and wrote gc.routed_to on root wpl-dz8, then diagnose failed with ENOBUFS because gc session list --json emitted a very large raw session payload. City-level default sessions also start during gc init independent of the suspended rig. Next contract should avoid controller poke/container expansion for no-nudge routing, or use a Waypoint metadata-only fallback.

Defined safe no-nudge contract: with current Gas City CLI/API, Waypoint must not call gc sling for --gascity-no-nudge because the sling path lacks exposed SkipPoke/route-only controls and can signal controller reconciliation. no-nudge means Waypoint-owned metadata-only delegation: update the Beads route root with gc.routed_to=<target>, verify the metadata, append the route runtime event, and return. This path may not start, wake, poke, or depend on Gas City sessions. Timeout/error ownership is the Beads metadata mutation and verification boundary. Explicit Gas City dispatch remains a separate nudge-enabled gc sling path until Gas City exposes a proven route-only primitive.

Defined safe nudge-enabled execution contract from live probes. Direct gc sling <target> <Waypoint route root> fails because the Waypoint root is a standard Beads epic and Gas City 1.1.0 reports first-class support for convoys only; omitting --no-formula does not change that. The proven contract is: keep the Waypoint route root as a standard epic, create a Gas City-owned convoy wrapper with gc convoy create waypoint-route-001 <route-root-bead-id>, then dispatch with gc sling <target> <convoy-id> --no-formula --nudge. Observed behavior: Gas City creates a convoy bead, makes the Waypoint route root its child, expands the convoy, attaches its default execution wisp to the route root, writes gc.routed_to=<target> on the child, and wakes the target when no matching session is running. No-nudge remains metadata-only and must not create or sling a convoy. Updated docs/plans/2026-05-27-waypoint-gascity-runtime.md with this contract.
